info.title: FlightDeck portal API — feature 005 delta
info.description: What feature 005 adds to FlightDeck's own API (served at /api/flightdeck/v1). The domain, mutation, telemetry and async endpoints of features 001 to 004 are unchanged and are not repeated here.

get.summary: One page of the unified stream: every selected source, merged and normalised.
get.description: Answers with the events and, always, the state of every source — including the ones that could not be read, with their reason. A source that is absent is never simply missing from the answer (spec FR-010).

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Comma-separated source ids; every source when absent.

parameters.name: includeUnknown
parameters.description: Whether events whose source stated no severity are included. Unknown is outside the ordering, so it is chosen, never implied (spec FR-003c).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous answer; asks for older events.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Live follow: only events newer than this.

get.summary: The original record of one event, fetched on demand.
get.description: Audit records carry a three-part key (utcTimeStamp, systemID, auditIndex); file sources carry their line. Where the original cannot be recovered the answer says so and the normalised fields still stand (spec FR-005).

200.description: The original record, or the reason it is gone

get.summary: The filtered result as a file, with every event's original record.
get.description: Carries exactly what the filter selected, and names in the file the filters that produced it and the sources that were unavailable (spec FR-022, FR-023).

id.description: Stable across refreshes, so live follow does not duplicate.

timestamp.description: In the instance's time zone, which the page states.

severity.description: unknown is the fifth value, outside the ordering: what a source that states no level gets. It is never inferred from the text (spec FR-003a, FR-003b).

namespace.description: Absent when the source does not provide one; never guessed.

raw.description: The original record. Mandatory wherever it can be recovered (RN-FD-24).

rawReason.description: Why the original is gone, when it is.

parsed.description: False for a line that did not match its source's shape; the line is then the message and nothing is dropped.

correlate.description: The entities this event can open: process, namespace, user (RN-FD-26).

reason.description: Why it could not be read, in the platform's words, plus where to change it where that applies.

suppressed.description: Events this source had beyond the limit; stated, never dropped in silence (spec FR-018).

namespaces.description: For the interoperability source: which namespaces were read, and the cap that applied.

unread.description: What a cap or a refusal left out, named.

sources.description: Every source, always, including the unavailable ones.

cursor.description: Asks for older events. Carries each file's size and modification time, so a growing file does not shift pages already served.

fileChanged.description: Set when a file rotated or was truncated under the reader (spec FR-014).

timeZone.description: The instance's zone: an event's time is a fact about the instance, not about the reader.

filters.description: The filters that produced this export, in the file itself.

sources.description: Including the ones that were unavailable when it was taken.
